_comment: RETIRED action layer. Tool action classification (read/write/destructive) is now done SOLELY by the VerbNet-grounded lexicon in app/services/verb_action_classifier.py (Policy Studio > Action Classification). The former prefix-based action_rules — and the earlier per-MCP capability_rules / fallbacks / selection_tolerance_policy — have been removed: TS-PHOL derives capabilities agnostically as {domain}:{action} and needs no per-MCP vocabulary. This stub is retained only so legacy loaders (decision_engine's optional selection_tolerance_policy lookup, experiment policy snapshots) still resolve.
